one_liner: Free team chat and messaging app (Slack alternative) from CAKE.com.

auth.evidence_quote: Click on API in the left sidebar. Select Add API key. Enter API key name. Click Generate
auth.notes: Pumble's public API uses a generated API key rather than OAuth; no third-party OAuth flow for acting on other workspaces was found.

access.evidence_quote: By using the Pumble API addon, you can interact with Pumble's API documentation without using any complex authentication processes
access.notes: Pumble has a free plan and API keys are self-generated from workspace settings; no separate review process found.

api.evidence_quote: Pumble offers an MCP server to connect external AI agents (Claude, Gemini, Codex) to Pumble so they can search, read, and act
api.notes: MCP mention found via search snippet from pumble.com (vendor domain), not independently fetched/verified for a repo URL; breadth assumed narrow since API is described as simple key-based messaging/reactions, not confirmed against a full reference index.

verdict.rationale: Free account with self-generated API key gives immediate working access with no documented extra gate.
